Hum to Piano

Hum a tune for up to 10 seconds. The app finds each note you hummed, shows it on a piano roll, and plays it back on piano.

Tap to hum
Hum on "mmm" or "doo", one clear note at a time. Recording stops by itself after 10 seconds.

What you hummed

Detected noteYour actual pitch
    Tips for clean results
    • Use a quiet room and hold the phone about 30 cm from your mouth.
    • Hum each note steadily. A tiny break or a "d" between repeated notes helps the app count them.
    • The number under each note is how far you were from the exact pitch, in cents (100 cents is one semitone). Tap a note to hear it.
    • "Allow for overall sharp or flat" helps when the whole tune drifted a little away from A = 440 Hz, as unaccompanied singing often does.
